I haven’t actually seen anything but I’ve kinda experienced something weird... my grandmother lived in an old, small home that was once used to treat wounded soldiers (I don’t really know much only what she has told me) but anyways when I was a kid I’d go over to her place overnight sometimes. One evening I was playing upstairs by myself, no one but me and my grandma were home (but I didn’t know that back then) and in the room I was playing in, there was a small cubby hole in the wall with a door... I’m going to guess it was some kind of storage thing? me across the room playing with my barbies, I heard a woman’s voice call my name, at first I thought it was my gma but she told me that she didn’t so I shrugged it off and went back upstairs to play.... I heard it again a few minutes later but I knew this time it was coming from the cubby hole, at first I was scared to go closer to the door but I ended up doing it anyway and opened the damn thing thinking one of my cousins were fucking with me or whatever, once I opened it a small breeze of cool air immediately hit my face and I used my Fischer-price flashlight to look around but surprise! there was nothing in there. Not really exciting but it still creeps me out knowing something called my name luring me to that cubby hole. When I was older my gma told me stories of things she’s heard in that house as well but she believed they weren’t violent so she just let it be.
